description.text: In a deep tunnel, the black mouth of the bore swallows almost all detail.

rests low in the near-dark, its body reduced to a long silhouette and a thin rim of ambient light tracing the roof and door line. The concrete walls recede into unlit distance; damp patches hold a faint gray sheen, and the road surface carries a soft, dusty film. Ahead, deeper shadow pools beneath the tunnel crown. The air reads still and cool, with grit and faint tyre marks textured into the floor. The car eases forward by degrees rather than lunging: tyres begin to turn, suspension settles, and the first small shift of weight moves through the chassis. The surrounding dark remains heavy, so the motion reads as a slow negotiation with the tunnel rather than a clean departure. Near-black stillness gives way to the first forward creep, while low tunnel rumble and a faint tyre roll press against the quiet.
; only a thin ambient rim separates the body from the black.
A low tunnel rumble moves through the concrete, soft and continuous.
eases forward; tyres begin to turn and the suspension settles under the first creep.
A faint tyre roll and a distant air draft thread through the rumble.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

pulls forward until the headlights flare across the tunnel, a relay click preceding the hard white wash. The beam opens a widening pool on the concrete, catching seams, cable brackets, and a wet gleam along the lower wall. As the nose breaks clear, the car's full shape resolves from hood to roofline, its surface picking up the new light while the rear remains briefly in shadow. The car keeps moving through the brightened space, rolling past the last heavy darkness as the low score swells beneath engine note and tyre roll. What was a silhouette becomes a clear moving object, and the tunnel around it shifts from black enclosure to lit passage.
pulls forward out of the darkness as the brighter space opens.
A headlight relay clicks, and a low engine note rises beneath the tyre roll.
The headlights flare and open a widening pool of light across the tunnel walls and concrete floor.
The low score swells under the engine note and the steady tyre roll.
carries through the brightened passage, clear against the receding dark.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at fast speed.
